tools.description: List reservations of the property (new, modified, canceled), newest data first as HotelRunner returns them, 1-50 per page. tools.name: hotelrunner_get_reservation
tools.description: One reservation by its HotelRunner code (hr_number, e.g. R377873409) or the sales channel's own reservation code, with the full vendor record (rooms, daily prices, extras, payments, guest and billing details, next_states). If the reservation is older than HotelRunner's lookup window, pass from_date.

tools.name: hotelrunner_list_channels
tools.description: All sales channels HotelRunner supports (name and code, e.g. bookingcom, expedia, hrs, online). The code is what hotelrunner_update_room_calendar takes in channel_codes. Counts as one of the property's 250 requests per day (5 per minute). GET /api/v2/apps/infos/channels.

tools.name: hotelrunner_list_connected_channels
tools.description: The channels this property is connected to, each with counts of calendar update processes in progress, succeeded and failed. Counts as one of the property's 250 requests per day (5 per minute). GET /api/v2/apps/infos/connected_channels.

tools.name: hotelrunner_get_transaction_details
tools.description: Per-channel status of a calendar update: pass the transaction_id returned by hotelrunner_update_room_calendar. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hotelrunner_get_transaction_details · Private data: hotelrunner_list_reservations, hotelrunner_get_reservation · Public sink: hotelrunner_update_room_calendar, hotelrunner_update_reservation_state.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hotelrunner_get_transaction_details · Private data: hotelrunner_list_reservations, hotelrunner_get_reservation · Public sink: hotelrunner_update_room_calendar, hotelrunner_update_reservation_state

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
